One click from the landing page reaches the step-1 form and 8-11 fields are observed, but the inputs carry NO name, no stable attribute and only React-generated ids containing an epoch stamp (#spi_nationality_1785693541603 — regenerated every page load), so the only selector left is a deep CSS path that cannot re-verify in a second session. Ellis refuses to release on selectors it knows are unstable. Needs either a label-anchored selector strategy or an attended run.
